scenarios.name: Bull – OpenAI MRA Delivers, Wafer-Scale Decode Wins
scenarios.notes: OpenAI 750MW deploys on schedule and the 1.25GW option is exercised; AWS Bedrock ramp + AMD disaggregation make Cerebras the default fast-decode layer; RPO ($25.4B) converts on schedule. Revenue ~$9B by 2031 at ~25% core net margin -> EPS ~$8; 40x exit for the category-defining inference franchise.

scenarios.name: Base – Committed Capacity Delivers, Optionality Lapses
scenarios.notes: The committed 750MW OpenAI tranches and initial AWS lease deliver; the 2GW option lapses; inference pricing erodes as GPU decode improves. Revenue ~$4.5B by 2031 at ~18% core net margin -> EPS ~$3.3; 30x exit as growth normalizes post-2028.

scenarios.name: Bear – OpenAI Entanglement Breaks / Decode Reverts to GPU
scenarios.notes: SemiAnalysis thesis confirmed: OpenAI shifts future decode to Nvidia GPUs; an MRA tranche miss triggers termination rights and WC-loan acceleration; RPO impairs. Fixed-cost data-center leases (~$2.25B signed, not commenced) bite; revenue stalls near $1.5B; re-rating to a sub-scale hardware multiple. EPS ~$0.6 by 2031.

evidence_for: RPO $25.4B at 2026-06-30 (vs $24.6B at 2025-12-31), majority attributable to the OpenAI MRA; ~22% recognizable within 24 months [10-Q 2026-08-12; confirm pass 80%].
OpenAI MRA (signed Dec 2025): 750MW committed 2026-2028, option to 2.0GW by 2030; 'valued at more than $20 billion' [S-1 2026-04-17, verbatim-confirmed].

AWS Commercial Agreement June 2026: first hyperscaler deployment, multi-year lease, exclusivity and capacity guarantees; Trainium-3 prefill + Cerebras decode; Bedrock integration targeted Q1 2027 [10-Q s_0006_c05; Q1/Q2 2026 releases].
Revenue $510.0M FY2025 (+76%); Q2 2026 $180.1M (+74% YoY); FY2026 core revenue guide raised to $880-890M; CFO plans to 'more than triple revenue in 2027' [S-1; 10-Q; Q2'26 release].
Core (non-GAAP) net loss only $(6.9)M in Q2 2026 / $(9.4)M H1 — near breakeven ex-IPO SBC and warrant amortization [10-Q s_0002_c17/19].
Liquidity: $7.4B cash+restricted + $1.2B securities + undrawn $850M revolver at 2026-06-30 [10-Q; confirm pass 80%].
Supply-chain wedge: 'We do not use HBM memory, CoWoS packaging or 3nm fabrication technology, all of which are currently supply limited' [Q2'26 release, verbatim].
evidence_against: Concentration: Q2 2026 Customer A 34% / B 32% / C 10% (A = MBZUAI by AR cross-reference; B matches OpenAI MRA revenue magnitude); two customers = 76% of receivables [10-Q s_0001_c06/07].

OpenAI entanglement: OpenAI is anchor customer + $918.2M lender (6% WC loan, accelerates if MRA terminated other than for OpenAI breach) + warrant holder (up to 33.4M Class N shares @ $0.00001; 10.0M exercised Jul 2026) [10-Q s_0001_c07/10/20; confirm pass 80%].
SemiAnalysis report (early Oct 2026): OpenAI's future 'Ultrafast' mode to run on Nvidia GPUs, not Cerebras — attacks the RPO anchor; ~20% drawdown wk of 2026-09-28 [SECONDARY, unverified at source].
Warrant amortization is contra-revenue through October 2031 ($44.3M in Q2 2026); GAAP margins optically suppressed for years [10-Q].
Material weaknesses in ICFR; disclosure controls 'not effective' at 2026-06-30 [10-Q s_0006_c03].
Stock $146.62 (2026-10-12) is 21% below the $185 IPO price; 52wk range $145.75-385.00; lockup on ~171M shares expires ~2026-11-09 [quote vendors, SECONDARY; 424B4].
Insider selling: 46 Forms 4 in first 4 months post-IPO, zero open-market buys, ~1.29M shares sold $161-250 [EDGAR Forms 4/144].
~$2.25B of data-center leases signed Q2+Q3 2026 not yet commenced — fixed-cost model mismatch vs consumption-priced inference [10-Q s_0001_c19/20].
open_questions: Does the SemiAnalysis Nvidia-for-Ultrafast claim survive reading the original report? Is it a prefill/decode nuance or a real OpenAI decode shift?
Is Customer B (32% of Q2 2026 revenue) OpenAI? Filing does not equate them.
Does CS-3/CS-4 clustering use Ethernet at scale, and whose fabric? (ANET cross-thesis hook.)
Lockup mechanics: exact releasable share count (~171.1M) and timing vs the Q3 2026 earnings date.
RPO survivability: how much of the $25.4B is exposed to OpenAI tranche-termination rights?
G42 post-IPO equity stake and the G42-to-Class-N non-voting mapping (UNVERIFIED).
Q3 2026 print (~mid-Nov): core revenue vs the $214-216M guide, first print into lockup expiry.

predictions.claim: Q3 2026 core (non-GAAP) revenue lands at or above the $214M guidance low end (reported ~mid-Nov 2026)
predictions.notes: Guide was raised in Aug; a miss into the ~Nov 9 lockup expiry compounds the supply overhang with a credibility break.

predictions.claim: No disclosure of OpenAI MRA termination, delivery-tranche miss, or material renegotiation in any SEC filing through the FY2026 10-K
predictions.notes: The SemiAnalysis Nvidia-for-Ultrafast report (Oct 2026) is the live threat; the MRA grants OpenAI termination rights on missed capacity tranches/SLAs and accelerates the $918M WC loan.

predictions.claim: FY2027 core revenue is >= $2.6B (>= ~3x the $885M FY2026 guide midpoint), per CFO Komin's stated plan to 'more than triple revenue in 2027'
predictions.notes: Requires the OpenAI 750MW ramp plus AWS contribution to land on schedule; RPO schedule has only ~22% recognizable in the first 24 months.

predictions.claim: AWS reaches >= 10% of revenue (a lettered customer) in a 10-Q or 10-K by FY2027 reporting
predictions.notes: June 2026 AWS Commercial Agreement has minimum capacity guarantees and 'material percentage of revenue' language, but Bedrock integration is only targeted for Q1 2027.

decision_journal.situation: CBRS at $146.62 (~$35B cap) trades 21% below its May 2026 IPO price ($185) after four selloffs (post-Q1 margins, post-Q2, SemiAnalysis Nvidia-for-Ultrafast report, lockup approach). Fundamentals are dual-sided: $25.4B RPO anchored by the >$20B OpenAI MRA plus AWS/AMD partnerships vs extreme concentration (Q2 top customers 34%/32%/10%), OpenAI as customer+lender+warrant-holder, ICFR material weaknesses, and ~171M shares unlocking ~2026-11-09. Scenario-weighted 5-year expected CAGR is ~-3.4% from this entry on a $1.00 FY2027 core-EPS base.
alternatives_rejected: Initiate a starter position at ~$147 (rejected: negative scenario-weighted expected return; the two biggest unknowns — SemiAnalysis claim and lockup supply — resolve within weeks at no cost to waiting).
Buy before the Q3 print to front-run a lockup-absorption rally (rejected: event-timing bet, not a price/probability edge; a guide miss into lockup expiry is the worst path).

Drop coverage as uninvestable concentration (rejected: backlog quality and inference-architecture evidence are worth a tracked belief state with dated predictions; the OpenAI MRA alone is a market-structure signal for the ANET/GOOG theses).
